}}'''Redbord''' is a [[Domani]] street tough.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Redbord}}

== Activities ==
After King [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar]] goes missing, the King's Guard is disbanded by [[Milisair Chadmar]]. Redbord becomes a street tough guarding rich merchants. When [[Rand al'Thor]] returns to [[Bandar Eban]], he promotes him to lieutenant and charges him to start policing the city.

==Trivia==
Redbord is named for David Redbord, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
